title: PsiQuantum
summary: Part of the software team powering the quest to build a fault-tolerant quantum computer. Worked on Construct, the platform for designing and optimizing quantum algorithms.
body:
### Construct

Worked on [Construct](https://construct.psiquantum.com/), PsiQuantum's platform for designing and optimizing fault-tolerant quantum algorithms.

### Further reading

- [Inside Construct](https://www.psiquantum.com/news-import/inside-construct) — an introduction to Circuit Designer, Workbench, and Resource Analyzer.
- [Construct available to all developers](https://www.psiquantum.com/news-import/psiquantum-makes-construct-ftqc-software-available-to-all-developers) — the open-access release.
- [Launching Construct](https://www.psiquantum.com/news-import/psiquantum-launches-construct) — the original software-suite announcement.

Screenshots below show the public homepage, the Ripple Carry Adder sample in Circuit Designer, and PsiQuantum's introductory article.
